findings.locator: Section 6.1 intro before Appendix A / Appendix A register
findings.evidence: Intro states「下列九筆只用於算式示範」but Appendix A lists 18 entries (9 per Table 5: 2023/2024/2025 OPERATING_REVENUE, OTHER_INCOME, TOTAL_INCOME; plus 9 Appendix C-1 breakdown rows: GRANT_OR_DONATION, MEMBERSHIP_DUES, INTEREST_INCOME per year)
findings.impact: The stated count of nine contradicts the 18-row replacement register; only the Table-5 values are used in the arithmetic demonstration, so the sentence is ambiguous and could cause a reviewer to under-verify the register
findings.required_action: Change「九筆」to「十八筆」or scope the sentence explicitly to the nine Table-5 source values while noting the nine Appendix C-1 breakdown rows separately

findings.evidence: Non-comparable or non-positive denominator cases are marked「不適用」/「不套用一般增幅」where Blueprint wording specifies N/A plus HOLD
findings.impact: Terminology differs from the Blueprint's N/A convention, though the candidate does apply HOLD semantics elsewhere (e.g., 3.1代收款「差異未解即HOLD」, Table 9 REAL=UNKNOWN/HOLD) and the operational meaning is equivalent
